project_type: TypeScript monorepo-ish workspace producing two DeepSeek Harness (DSH) third-party bundles: dsh-glm-zcode (packages/glm) and dsh-hourness (packages/hourness); each row is a cordis plugin with apply(ctx) compiled from src/<dir>/ ; shared library src/shared/ ; client UI under ui/src/ (not touched in this task).
language: TypeScript strict + exactOptionalPropertyTypes, Node 22 --experimental-strip-types compatible (no TS parameter properties, no enums); .mjs scripts for CLIs and the probe.
build_system: npm scripts. `npm run build` = clean-dist + tsc for root, packages/glm, packages/hourness, ui + build-ui. `npm run preflight` = scripts/preflight-bundle.mjs (directory table in scripts/packages.mjs, manifests, patches, locale per row, composition, bare imports). `npm test` = preflight + verbatim gate + lint (eslint/knip/jscpd against baselines) + secrets scan + a long explicit list of `node --experimental-strip-types tests/<name>.spec.ts` in package.json: EVERY new spec file must be appended to that `test` script, otherwise knip reports it unused. New src/<dir>/ must be listed in scripts/packages.mjs (hourness.src) and new host rows in `rows` + packages/hourness/cordis.patch.yml (disabled: true) + src/shared/health.ts HOURNESS_ROWS (same order as the patch) + packages/hourness/locale/<row>/{en,zh}.json. `npm run probe` = L3 headless real-runtime scenarios (scripts/probe/run-probe.mjs), needs the local desktop runtime and `npm run build` first; run it only when a host row is touched.
